name: LVW World Heavyweight Championship
notes: Later referred to in the fed's own text simply as the "LVW Championship" and "LVW Title."
epitaph: LVW's top championship, crowned for the first time in a 60-minute Ironman match and, after an interval of untracked reigns, fought over again in a 30-man battle royal.

name: Las Vegas Championship
notes: El Gordo Grande won the first Las Vegas Championship, a bracelet, in the Final Table Match at Supershow On The Strip I and lost it to Erik Mateo (billed there as Eric Mateo) at Hard 8 (17 June 2006). No later card shows it change hands; in August 2009 Mateo says he left LVW still holding it. The bracelet The Captain holds in LVW's own "4:18" (posted 4 August 2009) is the separate Strip Championship he won from Olvir Arsvinnar at Snake Eyes (1 June 2009).
epitaph: A secondary title decided for the first time by a bracket of poker-table gimmick spots, awarded to whoever could put an opponent through the right table.

name: Strip Championship
notes: Created by The Floor in May 2009 as a bracelet 'and a ticket to the top': three successful defenses earn a shot at the LVW Champion on the next show, five earn the right to name the stipulation (the booker's announcement of 2 May 2009). The Captain beat Olvir Arsvinnar for the first bracelet at Snake Eyes (1 June 2009), after Aaron Roddick broke a bat over Olvir's head.
epitaph: A white-gold bracelet created in 2009 as a stepping-stone to the World title, first won on the strength of a run-in.
